-nocompile         -- skip rxc/rxas and reuse an existing .rxbin
-native            -- package a native executable from the compiled program
-nokeep            -- delete compile/link intermediates after the run
-l[library path]   -- exact library file path, or packaged name under CREXX_HOME/bin
-s[path]           -- additional source import root for the rxc phase
-i[path]           -- additional raw binary import root for the rxc phase
--import-rxas      -- allow the rxc phase to auto-import .rxas from binary roots
--diagnostics mode -- rxc diagnostics: localized or raw
--diagnostic-locale locale -- diagnostic locale such as en_GB or en_US
--linkmap path     -- write an rxlink map file when using -native
--link-keep-source -- keep source/TRACE debug metadata in the linked native image
--link-keep-inline -- keep inline-body metadata in the linked native image
Source files without OPTIONS use rxc file-type defaults: .rexx is Level C
Options -s, -i and --import-rxas affect compilation only; runtime/native loading uses -l.
Native packaging uses rxlink before rxcpack; declared provider archives and explicit
plugin/static libraries are linked with platform-appropriate retention flags.
all options can also be prefixed with --
